ui.hub.adoption.title: Review existing skill
ui.hub.adoption.preservation: Preview saves a complete restorable snapshot without changing your skill or its link. Confirm writes only the reviewed proposal and creates the Hub link with the selected subscription policy. Cancel leaves the skill and link untouched; the snapshot remains.
ui.hub.adoption.model_consent: Allow the configured model to receive skill text and consolidate overlapping content. Leave off to review without a model.
ui.hub.adoption.stale: The local skill, Hub revision, or policy changed. Create a new preview before confirming.
ui.hub.adoption.failed: The operation did not complete. No adoption is confirmed. Create a new preview to try again.
ui.hub.adoption.needs_choice: No complete consolidation is available. Choose which version to use, review its new preview, then confirm. Nothing is chosen automatically.
ui.hub.adoption.no_proposal: No text proposal. See the file disposition above; original local bytes remain in the snapshot.
ui.hub.adoption.applied: Skill adopted. The reviewed content and Hub link are saved; your original files remain in the snapshot.
ui.hub.adoption.file_aside: Not installed; preserved in snapshot only
ui.hub.adoption.file_relocated: Move local guidance to this path
